cycles.invalidPrecondition: Recorded before Start; never retrospectively changes a started attempt denominator
cycles.failedStart: Retain attempt; classify no-asset only after authenticated unchanged inventory; unknown identity/loss prevents PASS
cycles.preservationOrUnclassifiedFailure: Halt safely and retain all receipts; no denominator reset or replacement campaign

longRuns.callbacks: Dedicated HandlerThread SCREEN_ON/OFF broadcasts and PowerManager thermal listener registered before capture, removed after Stop, final acknowledged queue barrier retained
longRuns.screenWake: Any wake in screen-off window or through conservative final callback barrier invalidates; intentional wake occurs after Stop/barrier
longRuns.process: Same process PID, actual native AudioRecord state/session, unsilenced built-in mic config and recording FGS; host independently checks OS service state

controls.radios: Record actual Wi-Fi/mobile state before each run; no deliberate route/network changes during capture

storage.snapshots: Before Start and after full finalized authenticated readback, before test deletion; no other vault operation during bracket
storage.growth: For every regular file and directory: positive size and st_blocks*512 growth; sum each dimension separately, use their maximum. File shrink never cancels another file growth. Include all common DB/WAL growth conservatively.
storage.duration: Full canonical capture duration = readbackFrames / 16000 seconds; includes setup/stop PCM outside minimum 3600s screen-off interval. No exact-slice attribution claim.
independentMonotonicDiagnostics: actual frame delta without invented threshold

resources.captureCounters: Per-run deltas; lifetime high-water explicitly labelled
